items.text: G6070: let the Oct 30 rebate lapse
items.summary: COO, CFO, Devil's Advocate and Doc (4 of 6) vote no on the roughly $21K deposit for now. Nothing on disk yet shows Epson's written printhead coverage, on-site Lubbock service, or a quality test or owner calls. QuickBooks shows checking at -$2,258.91 posted, but the bank feed hasn't been refreshed since 10/19. If you buy later, the board wants one Quatro kept through peak, not an even swap.
items.rec: Do it (let it lapse) unless Epson's written answer lands before Thursday.
